Definition: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
BiblicalUsage: 1) tent; 1a) nomad's tent, and thus symbolic of wilderness life, transience; 1b) dwelling, home, habitation; 1c) the sacred tent of Jehovah (the tabernacle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
